scope: Committed repository artifacts only; not a live production or market-data audit.
hypothesis: Missing outcome evidence in the committed screening ledger prevents testing whether candidate ranking produces investment value; identify the evidence path before changing ranking.

benchmark.sample_definition: All committed screener/runs artifacts matching existing schema filenames, ledger thesis/candidate projections, integrity reviews, and board index at baseline_commit. Includes explicitly labelled fixtures for structural checks only.
benchmark.candidate_comparison: Baseline only; no experimental candidate or investment-performance comparison.
benchmark.schema_failure_unit: 15 failing artifact documents, including mirrored run/ledger projections; not 15 independent signal failures.

standing: baseline established; predictive improvement and annual-return target not yet measurable

investment_evidence.return_horizons: Quarter, two-quarter, and one-year portfolio outcomes not computed in this pass.
investment_evidence.uncertainty: Committed artifacts may lag owner-private runtime output. Explicit fixture flags are excluded from the non-fixture overdue tally; unlabelled legacy examples are not assumed to be independent prospective forecasts. Schema conformance does not prove source correctness, point-in-time availability, or forecasting skill.

next.action: Round 2: trace one non-fixture due checkpoint through the existing validator and full-content source handoff, and inspect whether the historical schema failures are rejected at new-publication admission. Distinguish committed-ledger gaps from owner-private runtime output. Preserve evidence caps; do not dispatch paid research or mutate production.
next.acceptance_rule: An exact checkpoint, issuer/listing, due window, original threshold, source-content path, recorded outcome or precise missing-input reason, and one bounded next correction.
next.cost_budget: Built-in search and direct public sources only; no external paid providers or API credits.
guardrails: Preserve original forecasts and thesis artifacts.
No frontend changes or real trading.
No ranking/performance claim based on fixtures or missing labels.

dependencies: Outcome evidence absent from committed rows is not proof that the live production loop failed. Verify using existing read-only diagnostics.
Shared extraction/benchmark defects belong to the cockpit lane; hand off concrete evidence before duplicating shared logic.

delivery.change_kind: append-only baseline evidence; no runtime or prompt changes
delivery.worktree: Managed screening-improvement checkout attached to the automation chat.

provenance.method: Existing validate_screener_json.validate plus integrity anchor checks; strict local NDJSON parsing; existing screener_calibrate.build without calling its writing entry point. Due dates use the first ISO date component <= as_of_date; resolution joins exact checkpoint_id.
